Class Shaman

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Model.Cards.Card
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Model.Cards.CharacterCards.CharacterCard
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Model.Cards.CharacterCards.Shaman
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Shaman extends CharacterCard
Represents the Shaman character card. Shamans provide spiritual icons that are essential for satisfying specific era requirements and unlocking shamanic bonuses.
